name: fmt
archiveDigestAuthority: Locally computed SHA256 of official immutable-commit codeload source archive; distinct from publisher digest of the separate release ZIP.
integration: Existing static traditional fmt::fmt engine target with PIC. Explicit FMT_MODULE OFF; subdirectory EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL keeps new unconsumed fmt-c target out of engine all builds.
notes: Upstream 12.2.0 auto-enables optional C++ modules with modern CMake/Ninja/compiler combinations and adds an unconditional C API library. Recoil uses headers/compiled fmt::fmt; those new targets are not engine requirements.
